editorialLexicalPolicy.evidenceBoundary: Spanish realization options and constraints only. These entries never override source surface, morphology, syntax, discourse, or canonical corpus evidence.
editorialLexicalPolicy.instruction: Preserve the source relation of work or service. When the service is cultual, express that cultual relation without erasing the service component or merging it with a separate bowing token.

spanishOptions.when: Service to a person, authority, people, deity, or idol is foregrounded.
The construction explicitly presents cultual service and natural Spanish benefits from making that relation explicit.

avoid: using adorar as an automatic replacement
merging service with a separate bowing or homage token

editorialLexicalPolicyReview.title: Adorar, postrarse, servir y rendir culto
editorialLexicalPolicyReview.summary: Abad spans ordinary work, political or personal service, and service to God or idols; its service relation must remain visible.
